figures.claim: On the tibia there are two reference points: the posteromedial tubercle for the direct arm of semimembranosus, and the distal attachment of the collateral ligament about 6 cm below the joint line.

Conventional teaching places the adductor tubercle about 12 mm proximal and 3 mm posterior to the medial epicondyle, and the gastrocnemius tubercle about 10 mm distal and 5 mm posterior to the adductor tubercle.
